Blackstone structure is in the eastern wing visible after navigating past the smoker kitchen
Potted acacia sapling is in the greenhouse accessed through the white carpet hallway
Potted red tulip is in the same greenhouse area requiring passage through the white carpet hall
Redstone block is embedded in the blackstone structure and must be located first
Dead brain coral is in the aquarium section behind the blackstone structure

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The smoker is at spawn-relative (0, 0, 5). max_distance=4 ensures the player must move at least 1 block forward from spawn (which is 5 blocks away). facing_tolerance=45 ensures the player is looking toward the smoker.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. White carpet is at (-4, 0, 4) in the western hallway. max_distance=4 requires the player to enter the hallway (spawn is ~5.7 blocks away). facing_tolerance=45 ensures the player is looking at the carpet.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The decorative polished_blackstone_brick_wall blocks are at (5-7, 1, 3) on the front face of the eastern structure. Target (6,1,3) is the center wall block. max_distance=5 requires approaching the structure (spawn is ~6.7 blocks away). facing_tolerance=45 ensures the player is looking at the wall.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The potted acacia sapling is at (-9, 0, 6) inside the greenhouse. max_distance=5 requires entering the greenhouse (spawn is ~10.8 blocks away). facing_tolerance=45 ensures the player is looking at the potted plant.

Uses inventory_has because mining a potted_red_tulip drops a red_tulip and a flower_pot into inventory. The red_tulip is not in starting inventory, so its presence confirms the block was mined. This is preferred over position-based rules because it directly verifies the mining action occurred.

Uses inventory_has because mining a redstone_block with an iron pickaxe drops the redstone_block item into inventory. The player is given an iron_pickaxe via /give. redstone_block is not in starting inventory, so its presence confirms successful mining with the correct tool tier.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The dead brain coral (fan variant) is placed at (6, 1, 9) on a stone pedestal in the aquarium. max_distance=5 requires entering the aquarium area (spawn is ~10.8 blocks away). facing_tolerance=45 ensures the player is looking at the coral.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The bee nest is at (-10, 2, 10) attached to an oak tree in the garden beyond the greenhouse. max_distance=6 requires reaching the garden area (spawn is ~14.3 blocks away). facing_tolerance=45 ensures the player is looking toward the bee nest (which is elevated at y=2).

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The mooshroom is summoned at (0, 0, 16) in the rear fenced pasture. max_distance=6 requires reaching the pasture area (spawn is 16 blocks away). facing_tolerance=45 ensures the player is looking at the mooshroom. The fenced area (x=-5 to 5, z=14-18) keeps the mooshroom within range of the target point.

scene_description: A multi-wing compound built around a central starting area. The player spawns facing south toward a kitchen with a smoker. Two wings branch from the kitchen: a western hallway with white carpet leading to a greenhouse (potted acacia sapling, potted red tulip) and garden (bee nest on oak tree), and an eastern passage to a polished blackstone bricks enclosure with decorative polished_blackstone_brick_wall elements (redstone block embedded in back wall, aquarium with dead brain coral behind). Both wings connect to a rear fenced pasture with a mooshroom.
task_text: Explore the compound starting from the kitchen. Find the smoker, then explore both wings. Left wing: follow the white carpet hallway to the greenhouse, find the potted acacia sapling, mine the potted red tulip, then find the bee nest in the garden beyond. Right wing: find the polished blackstone brick wall decorations on the eastern structure, mine the redstone block embedded in its back wall (use your iron pickaxe), and find the dead brain coral in the aquarium. Finally, reach the rear pasture and find the mushroom cow.
